Audit wiki/concepts/metronome/metronome-custom-fields.md and add fact-bearing plus reciprocal-source-link suggestions: this response schema establishes that a billable metric can expose custom_fields as an arbitrary-key object whose values are strings, while key, value, count, visibility, and redaction limits remain undocumented.

Replace or supplement the grounding quotes, within the 3-5 quote limit, so the durable shared update is directly supported for the 1-100 limit, required data and nullable next_page, required metric id and name, and the aggregation_key/example conflict; then update quote_indexes accordingly.
